System Diagram

You provide the intent. The role sets the boundaries. AI writes the letter.

  1. YouLetter request

    Recipient, facts, tone and language.

  2. Role CardThank-You Letter

    The selected Role Card becomes the system instruction.

  3. GeminiWrite the letter

    Uses your request and the Role Card. No invented facts or follow-up chat.

  4. Typewriter → LettersPrint & save

    The finished letter prints on paper and is saved on this browser for viewing only.

The assistant writes letters. It does not send them. Your saved letters and custom Role Cards stay in this browser; generating a letter sends that request and Role Card to Google.
